verdicts.en: The imam and hadith scholar, the great transmitter of his age.

bio: Deafness struck him in his twenties, after he returned from his travels, and later became total (hence the name). He transmitted for seventy-six years, and students travelled to Nishapur from every country to hear him; al-Hakim was among them.
